title: [NativeFace B1] Give Birth Plot choices genuine checked Boolean controls
body:
Parent: #5357 (native Face UX). Related semantic controls: #5372 (Mask interlock), #5367 (certified accessible roles), #5604 (installed native action routing). This is the **first quick win** from the 2026-10-18 QEMU Crèche review.

## Outcome
On the normal ConduitOS Crèche, a selectable starting Plot appears as an actual checked/unchecked native control, not a prose line or an action demanding that the user manually enter `false`/`true`. Both pointer and keyboard use the **existing** exact `Include Plot(value/bool)` source action, and the freshly acknowledged Face/Show supplies its subsequent state.

## Current code and observed gap
- `plots/birth/src/widget_face.rs` already exposes `ChoiceGroup { multiplicity: Independent }`, `selected` for each choice, and its `creche.plot.{index}` Boolean change action.
- `plots/birth/src/face/projection.rs` currently lowers each option to a named `FaceRole::Plot`, readable `Included.`/`Not included.` text and a typed Boolean argument, **but no machine-readable current checked value on that projected subject**.
- `targets/conduitos/src/native_face_scene/document.rs` lowers that argument as a separate `false or true` prompt; `input.rs` commits only supplied arguments, so activating a bare argument-bearing row can yield `IncompleteInput` (observed QEMU refusal: `native-face-mask-input-incomplete`).

## Thin implementation
1. Carry the BirthDraft-selected bit into the checked, source-derived Face as a real Boolean property on the corresponding Plot subject, retaining its exact action/subject identity, availability, and existing readable linear fallback. Do **not** parse the English strings `Included.`/`Not included.` to infer state.
2. In the native Mask recognize a **verified reversible Boolean choice**: a current value, a compatible offered one-Boolean-argument change action, and an exact binding between subject and action. A generic Boolean argument or a one-way `complete` action is **not automatically a checkbox**.
3. Paint a bounded checkbox + label and a visually distinct focus marker; assign only the real checked action's hit region. Space or Enter when focused, and a pointer activation, submit the opposite `value/bool` byte through the existing acknowledged Show → typed `FaceInteraction` → producer route. No renderer-local toggle of authoritative selection.
4. On successful source acceptance, reproject and show the new selected count, checked state, and Birth readiness; migrate focus using stable source action identity. Preserve refusal/availability truth and avoid a phantom toggle on stale Show, missing input, host loss or a disabled Plot.
5. Keep existing text/linear/browser semantic equivalence, source-pinned receipts and generic fallback. Reuse current graphics/compositor/typography; no new global checkbox Kind, UI state store or widget hierarchy.

## Acceptance
- [x] On a normal real QEMU Crèche with four included Plots, all four controls are visibly checked, named and reachable; unchecked choices remain discoverable through the real inventory/search.
- [x] Click and keyboard (Space/Enter per the admitted binding) on one currently checked Plot produce a correctly named `value/bool=false` typed interaction tied to the current Face/Show, and the accepted fresh Show visibly has three selected. Repeating submits `true`, restoring four.
- [x] The Birth-ready state and review count update from source after each successful commit. No extra Birth, no invented identity, no duplicate submission.
- [x] Focus versus checked versus disabled state each have non-color cues; selection remains accessible at narrow width and with pagination. A one-way Todo completion affordance is **not** misrepresented as reversible.
- [x] Stale Show, mismatched Face revision/action/argument, unsupported Boolean affordance and unavailable choice refuse without changing the draft. Text field incompleteness still refuses where appropriate.
- [x] Focused source/Face/native Mask tests and one real QEMU interaction trace with screenshot + source identity + Show/interaction/owner receipt. Respect 48 graphics commands, 192-byte text, current retained surfaces and `dev` gates.

## Ownership and stop line
Start at `plots/birth/src/face/projection.rs`, `targets/conduitos/src/native_face_scene/{document.rs,input.rs,frame.rs,layout.rs}`, and existing native Mask route only as needed. Coordinate ownership with #5604/#5607 under #5520; one native-scene implementation PR at a time. No broad component DSL, web DOM port or semantic Button/Checkbox taxonomy.
